newsitem.title: NORWAY: NORDIC SKIING-NORWAY TAKE RELAY GOLD, FINLAND SILVER.
newsitem.headline: NORDIC SKIING-NORWAY TAKE RELAY GOLD, FINLAND SILVER.

text.p: Bjorn Daehlie claimed his third gold medal as Norway underlined their domination of men's cross-country skiing with a comfortable win in the 4x10-km relay at the Nordic skiing world championships on Friday.
Sture Sivertsen, Erling Jevne, Daehlie and Thomas Alsgaard left their rivals way behind to clock a provisional winning time of one hour 37 minutes 06.10 seconds.
Finland came second two minutes 11.20 seconds back and Italy third 2:50.80 behind Norway, according to unofficial results.
The Norwegians, who led from start to finish to the roars of a huge crowd, were already 24 seconds clear of the Finns after the first two legs when Daehlie set off.
Daehlie, the winner of two golds already in the 10-day festival, increased their lead to one minute and 43 seconds.
The last two laps were a formality for Alsgaard, who took plenty of time to pick up a Norwegian flag in the finish straight and wave it until the line.
Finn Jari Isometsae was a distant second and Falvio Valbusia outsprinted Russian Alexei Prokurorov to give third place to Italy.
